state:
Goal `core-router-and-4-more`, stage 2 (feature proofs). `Core\Router::match`, `::methodsFor`, `::url`, `::urlAbsolute` and `::urlSigned` have every feature proof on disk: about, three examples, an attack, a bench, and a Rust `covers:` test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs`'s test module. `Core\Router` has its class card, and the `urlAbsolute` and `urlSigned` cards are rewritten in plain words.

`urlAbsolute`'s examples, attack and bench read an `[[app]] origin` from an `nvs.toml` beside them (`docs/examples/core/Router/urlAbsolute/`, `tests/hostile/core/Router/urlAbsolute/`, and `benches/members/core/Router/nvs.toml`, which every Router bench now runs under).

`signedRoute` has its Rust `covers:` marker on `signed_route_verifies_against_the_match_the_server_already_made_and_reparses_nothing`, and still owes about, examples, hostile and perf. All five `Core\Router\Match` members owe examples, help, hostile, perf and tests. `Core\Script`, `Core\Script\ExitReport` and `Core\Secret` are not started.

items.text: **`Core\Router::signedRoute`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`); its Rust test is marked. It reads the match the door took, so each example is a `.nvs` with a `.nvsr` request beside it (`docs/examples/README.md` § on `.nvsr`; `docs/examples/core/Request/body/` is the shape). A request's `_sig` must be minted by a key the program also holds, so an example signs with a fixed key built as `bytes` then `as secret bytes` (32 bytes). `SIGNED_ROUTE_DOC` wants a plain rewrite. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:1421`

**`Core\Router\Match`'s class card and its five members** — owes a `ClassDoc` above the class's `CLASS` row plus deletion from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`, then examples, hostile, perf and two `.nvst` cases each. The member cards start at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/router.rs:660`.

backlog: `Core\Script`, `Core\Script\ExitReport`, `Core\Secret` — every proof, and a class card each (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/script.rs`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/secret.rs`).
